description: OLE-BUFFER typed results through Connection.Execute (default forward-only server cursor): every Field's Name, Type, DefinedSize, Precision, NumericScale and Attributes of 'SELECT * FROM Items'; the column-level Properties of ID, Code, N, Txt, M and B; then Value and ActualSize of every field of each row (Null row, empty text and binary, 12,000-character memo and binary, wide text, ten-byte binary).
